Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Harker Heights for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Neon Christmas: You Pick Blacklight at Painting with a Twist) through December 19 (Kids Customizable Gingerbread House and the Christmas Tree Craft at the library), with Cookies and Cocoa with the City Council and the Christmas tree lighting (December 7) and Frost Fest (December 12) along the way. New in this update: the Christmas Tree Craft at the Harker Heights Public Library, plus Frost Fest and Cookies and Cocoa, which move over from the Killeen page. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Harker Heights

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Harker Heights
  • 2 free events: Frost Fest (December 12) and the Christmas Tree Craft at the library (December 19)
  • Meet Santa: Cookies and Cocoa with the City Council and the Christmas tree lighting (December 7) has pictures with Santa
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Christmas tree lighting at City Hall (December 7) and Frost Fest at Harker Heights Community Park (December 12)
  • Crafts: Neon Christmas (November 27), the Kids Customizable Gingerbread House (December 19) and the library's Christmas Tree Craft (December 19)
  • Season: November 27 to December 19

Planning a bigger day out? Harker Heights families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Killeen, which covers Nature In Lights at Fort Hood, the Christmas Parade and The Nutcracker at Central Texas Theatre.
